meta_description: Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience in Cloud Architecture, Mobile Development (Flutter) and Technical Leadership. Based in Colombia.
meta_og_description: Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience in Cloud Architecture, Mobile Development and Technical Leadership.
home_subtitle_intro: 7+ years building high-impact digital products. Specialized in **mobile architecture with Flutter**, **microservices on AWS**, and **technical leadership**. I've delivered enterprise solutions at
about_bio_p1: Systems Engineer with more than 7 years building digital products. I started as a **Fullstack Developer** and evolved into **Cloud Engineer**, **Software Engineer**, and **Mobile Dev Lead** roles at companies like **Condor Labs**, **Melonn**, and **Siigo**.
about_bio_p2: At **Melonn** I led the mobile team and designed the cloud architecture on **AWS**. Now at **Siigo** I build critical features for the POS web app with **Flutter**.
timeline_siigo_desc: Design and development of critical features for the POS web app with **Flutter**. Implementation of clean architecture, testing, and security best practices.
timeline_melonn_lead_desc: Led the mobile team responsible for all of the company's Flutter apps. Defined coding standards, mentored the team, and managed releases. Cut delivery time by **40%** through optimized CI/CD processes.
timeline_melonn_cloud_desc: Designed and implemented microservices and APIs on **AWS** (**Lambda**, **API Gateway**, **DynamoDB**, **SQS**). Built mobile apps with **Flutter** and backends with **Node.js** / **TypeScript**. Automated processes and system integrations.
timeline_condor_desc: Researched, designed, and implemented new features on legacy **C#** code. Stack: **React.js**, **Node.js**, **MongoDB**, **AWS** services (**S3**, **Lambda**, **CloudWatch**). Optimized existing processes and **Oracle DB** queries.
timeline_superpesos_desc: Developed and maintained microservices in **Node.js** on **AWS** (**Lambda**, **API Gateway**, **S3**, **CloudWatch**). Debugged production issues and built new endpoints.
timeline_freelance_desc: Built mobile and web applications for a range of clients. Varied stack: **Flutter**, **React**, **Angular**, **Vue**, **Node.js**, **PHP**, **Go**, **Laravel**. Projects spanning eCommerce to enterprise systems.
timeline_jqagencia_desc: Full development of an industrial resource management module. Frontend with **Angular** + **Ionic**, backend with **PHP** / **Laravel**, and a **MySQL** database.
projects_lead: Products in production and open source tools: Flutter apps, developer utilities, and enterprise systems.
projects_melonn_drivers_desc: App for Melonn drivers, where they can see their orders, routes, and other information relevant to their work.
projects_melonn_ops_desc: App for Melonn operators, used to manage several internal warehouse processes.
projects_estarbien_desc: App focused on providing guided psychoeducation and tools related to mental and physical health and emotional wellbeing.
projects_solutoday_desc: App that instantly locates the best available service professionals in your area for an on-demand experience.
projects_flutree_desc: Lifecycle management for Git worktrees across multiple repos, built for Flutter-oriented development workflows.
projects_perfscope_desc: Local performance observability for Flutter: on-device frame anomaly detection, sessions, reports, and comparisons.

reins_hero_lead: A personal phone-to-PC terminal for driving code agents. Traffic goes straight from the phone to the computer over SSH: no cloud, no account, no relay.
reins_piezas_note: Everything the phone reaches goes through an SSH tunnel to a gateway bound to loopback. None of this opens a port on your network.

reins_connectivity_lead: How the phone reaches your Mac. Local Wi-Fi is zero configuration but only works on the same network; Tailscale works from anywhere.

reins_wifi_p2: Two things break this and it's not Reins' fault. The LAN IP changes with DHCP, so the host saved in the app stops responding once the router reassigns it. And a lot of office or public networks have _client isolation_, which blocks one device from reaching another even on the same Wi-Fi. For daily use, Tailscale.
reins_tailscale_p1: Tailscale builds an encrypted WireGuard mesh between your devices. The phone reaches the Mac from any network, without opening ports or touching the router. Free for personal use.
reins_tailscale_p2_a: Install Tailscale on the phone and sign in with **the same account**. Both devices need to show up on the same tailnet. No need to note down the address:

reins_faq1_q: The app doesn't show OpenCode sessions
reins_faq1_a1: Almost always the gateway restarted and the sessions never re-registered. The plugin registers at startup and on reconnect, never retries, so a session older than the gateway is invisible to it.

reins_security_item1: **ed25519** keys, one per paired device, revocable individually.
reins_security_item2: **No private key ever touches disk** on the Mac; only the public half gets authorized.
reins_security_item3: **Trust on first use** for host keys: the app pins it on the first connection and refuses to connect if it changes.
reins_security_item4: **Gateway on loopback only**, reached through the SSH tunnel. Never exposed to your network.
reins_security_item5: **No agent APIs.** The chat view reads the agent's terminal output; it never calls Claude, Codex, or OpenCode directly.
